nodes.title: ⬡ Read me first
widgets_values:
MiniMax H3 -- text to video (with audio)

1  Load Model: pick your H3 fl2v checkpoint (this template ships the
   fl2va int8 name). ref2va is the image-to-video sibling -- for that
   variant add a Polyhedron MiniMax Reference between the prompt and
   the sampler and feed it your reference pictures.

2  Load CLIP: the qwen3vl text encoder, type = minimax.

3  Two VAEs: H3 is an AV model -- video VAE decodes the picture,
   audio VAE the sound. Both read the model input for their settings.

4  LoRA Engine: the H3 accelerator LoRAs ship here as DISABLED example
   rows. Enable the one that matches your checkpoint (8-step or
   4-step) and drop the sampler to 8 or 4 steps. Apply = Baked.

5  Prompt: one positive segment. H3 runs at CFG 1 -- a negative has
   nothing to push against (see the note there). Describe what you DO
   want.

6  Seed node: drag inside the noise field to scrub the seed, click to
   re-roll. It feeds the sampler's seed AND its noise input.

No other node pack is needed -- everything here is Polyhedron Suite.

nodes.title: ⬡ No negative on H3
widgets_values:
No negative prompt on H3

H3 runs at CFG 1: the sampler reads the positive only, a negative
has nothing to push against. That is why the sampler gets the
POSITIVE conditioning on both of its inputs.

NAG cannot help either. It guides inside a CROSS-attention, and H3
has none -- text, video and audio run as one joint sequence. The
Polyhedron NAG node refuses H3 and says so in the console, so this
template has no NAG node.

To keep something out of the picture, describe what you DO want.

nodes.title: ⬡ Attention
widgets_values:
Attention backend

sage fp8 cuda++ is the fastest path on a recent NVIDIA card, but it
needs Sage Attention installed. If the console says it is missing,
switch this to 'auto' -- the graph runs either way.

nodes.title: ⬡ Frames, not seconds
widgets_values:
Length and duration

H3 counts in latent frames: length 9 at 24 fps is about 3 seconds.
The node shows the resulting seconds under the fields. Keep width and
height on the 16-pixel grid; 1280x720 is the safe landscape default,
768x1344 the portrait one.
